name: Kinetic offer wall
description: Make one legitimate offer readable while showing the product range. Builds an editable 10-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.
tagline: An approved offer is the main reason to act, with a small product range.

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 10 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.text: Lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.
Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page with the finishing model and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.label: Agent
props.placeholder: The agent's reading and image searches appear here.

props.subtitle: Start with the offer. It is the reason to act, so it opens the ad and comes back before the end.

props.label: Offer
props.hint: Very short. It fills the top of the screen.

props.label: Offer terms
props.hint: Which products, and the end date.

props.subtitle: Three product cutouts on a plain or transparent background. The first one is the hero.

props.label: Benefit
props.hint: Shows while the hero product grows.

props.subtitle: Brand, product and the call to action hold together.

props.label: Layout agent
props.placeholder: The agent's layout edits and frame reviews appear here.

props.title: The layout needs a look
props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

creativeStrategy.objective: Make one legitimate offer readable while showing the product range.
creativeStrategy.direction: The offer is the hero; repetition creates texture but never competes with the readable offer.

shots.title: Oversized offer occupies the upper-middle canvas; one pack is already visible.

elements.direction: Word-staggered entrance, 75 ms offset; 260 ms per word; background rows drift 0.08 canvas widths.

shots.title: Three products share a consistent center and baseline.

elements.direction: Cut to a new pack every 500–750 ms. Each enters 0.12 widths over 240 ms, overshoot <=6%.

shots.title: Hero product grows while repeated copy recedes.

elements.direction: Slide background text off; product scale 1.00→1.08; benefit pops once.

shots.title: Offer, eligible product range and end date become a stable card.

elements.direction: 180 ms fade for supporting line; otherwise hold.
CTA settles within 200 ms; hold the remaining time.

value.title: Kinetic offer wall
value.objective: Make one legitimate offer readable while showing the product range.
value.direction: The offer is the hero; repetition creates texture but never competes with the readable offer.
beats: 0–1.5 s: Oversized offer occupies the upper-middle canvas; one pack is already visible. Shows Brand color, Hero product, Offer.
1.5–4 s: Three products share a consistent center and baseline. Shows Brand color, Hero product, Product 2, Product 3, Range name.
4–6.5 s: Hero product grows while repeated copy recedes. Shows Brand color, Hero product, Benefit.
6.5–8.5 s: Offer, eligible product range and end date become a stable card. Shows Brand color, Hero product, Product 2, Product 3, Offer terms.
8.5–10 s: Stable brand/product/CTA lockup. Shows Brand color, Hero product, Logo, Call to action.
